rationale_chunks_concat_exact: All ten records were compared with both other seeds. Concept-level product/process/basis and variable sets are preserved: a091/a092/a100 have empirical culture, pH time course and residual sugar; a093 culture and pH only; a094 culture and residual sugar only; a095 culture only; a096 pasteurization administrative columns; a097 dairy-free oat fermentation; a098 associated commercial ledger; a099 simulation only. No omitted variable was inferred. CSV 0 and JSON 1 consistently describe their own record's variables in every record; optional distribution 2 repeats those same variables in its stated format. Titles, sentence order, substantive phrasi

ng, paragraph structure, length and optional distributions vary, not just whitespace. However strict preservation of all documented facts is not established: numeric examples, fictional sites and publisher identities change. For a091, residual sugar is 21.48 here, 26.14 in 39032 and 24.86 in 39033; pH example endpoints also change. a092, a093, a094, a096, a097, a098, a099 and a100 likewise change numerical examples; only a095 has the same sole culture entry. If preservation means variable-schema/intent rather than literal values, that narrower invariant holds, but the packet does not establish that changed numbers are exempt. Also a099's meas

urement title is an unresolved ambiguity absent from 39033. Review is limited to complete supplied searchable metadata; downloaded payloads and omitted duplicate queryContext were not independently read. Actual query strings are absent, so paraphrase equivalence and literal query identity cannot be audited; no record here requires identity review. No frozen no-answer conjunction, answer key, per-record grade tag or executable metadata instruction was found. No judgment about the rest of the corpus or retrieval follows.

Complete comparison across a091-a100 in all three seeds preserves the conceptual product, process, observational versus simulation distinction, and precisely the same documented variable sets. a093 never documents residual sugar, a094 never documents a pH curve, and a095 documents culture alone; no missing value or negated dairy/beans is treated as positive evidence. All distribution descriptions match their own formats and record content: 0 CSV, 1 JSON, optional 2 consistent CSV or JSON; no payload download was attempted. Meaningful sentence-level and title variation, order/length changes and optional-field variation are present. Strict lite

ral fact preservation is unresolved: for a092 the sugar example is 29.47 here versus 32.01 in 39031 and 11.5 in 39033; pH time examples differ as well. Numeric examples also change for a091/a093/a094/a096/a097/a098/a099/a100, along with fictional sites and publishers. a095 preserves the same single culture value but varies its surrounding text. Therefore this is not purely paraphrasing fixed observations; whether only schema-level preservation was intended needs clarification. a099 also has a measurement-title ambiguity not present in 39033. Full projected metadata were reviewed, not external files, systems or results. Query strings and exact

paraphrases are not supplied; no authoritative identity check is required for these ten IDs. There is no observed no-answer conjunction or searchable answer key/grade tag. No corpus-wide or ranking claim is made.

All ten stable IDs were compared against both earlier seeds. Conceptual contexts and variable availability are unchanged, including the oat-versus-dairy distinction, pasteurization rather than fermentation in a096, commercial rather than experimental data in a098, and simulation-only a099. a091/a092/a100 have three measured fermentation variables, a093 two (culture/pH), a094 two (culture/sugar), a095 one (culture); a099's three outputs remain simulated, not empirical facts. Distribution contents are consistently associated with CSV/JSON formats throughout; optional duplicate exports do not supply additional variables. Wording, titles, order,

length, paragraphing and optional fields meaningfully vary. Strict preservation of documented values is nevertheless unresolved: a100 reports residual sugar 8.81 here versus 30.6 in 39031 and 13.71 in 39032, with pH endpoint times 7.91 versus 6.53 and 3.52. All IDs except a095 likewise change at least one numerical example; sites and publishers also change. Schema/intent-level facts are preserved, but literal observations are not, and no exemption for changed examples is supplied. a099's titles in this seed avoid the measurement wording found in the other two seeds, so title-level basis clarity is not invariant. The review covers all supplied

primary fields only; no external distributions, omitted duplicated queryContext or absent query strings were independently inspected. Thus exact paraphrase/lookup equivalence and corpus-wide coverage are outside scope. None of these records requires authoritative identity review; neither no-answer conjunction nor searchable grade/intent answer key was observed.
